nodes.label: #darkTipModal Samsung dark mode tip
nodes.rationale: Samsung Internet may force-darken pages despite color-scheme meta; dialog explains the browser setting.

nodes.label: color-scheme light dark meta
nodes.rationale: Declaring dark support stops Samsung Internet / Chrome auto-darkening; themes ignore the OS scheme so colors stay the same.

nodes.label: Neon Block Color Palette (#00fff0 cyan, #ff2bd6 magenta, #fff200 yellow on #140633)
nodes.norm_label: neon block color palette (#00fff0 cyan, #ff2bd6 magenta, #fff200 yellow on #140633)

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon PNG
nodes.rationale: iOS ignores the web manifest icons for home-screen shortcuts, so a dedicated apple-touch-icon is linked from index.html.

nodes.label: Block Fit App Icon (SVG source)
nodes.rationale: Single vector master; all PNG icon sizes are rendered from it so the brand mark stays consistent. Depicts 8 rounded neon blocks (cyan T-shape, magenta pair, yellow pair) on a dark purple rounded square, mirroring the game's neon block palette.

nodes.label: Maskable App Icon 192px PNG
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed dark background with the block group scaled into the central safe zone so Android adaptive-icon masks (circle, squircle) never clip the blocks.

nodes.label: Stone Floor Twist
nodes.rationale: Leaves one gap per stone row and never ends the game by itself.

nodes.label: Weighted Piece Generator
nodes.rationale: Tries to deal at least one fitting piece; larger pieces grow more common with score.

nodes.label: Level Checkpoint & Retry
nodes.rationale: Failing a level retries the same level, restoring score and rotate tokens from a checkpoint saved at level start in localStorage; survives reloads and settings changes.

nodes.label: Network-first Service Worker (CORE cache list)
nodes.rationale: Network-first so a new deploy shows on next launch while still working offline; new JS/CSS files must be added to CORE in sw.js.

nodes.label: No Build Step (pure ES modules)
nodes.rationale: Runs straight from GitHub Pages; ES modules need an HTTP server so file:// does not work.

nodes.label: High Scores per Settings Combination
nodes.rationale: Scores on a 10x10 board aren't comparable to a 6x6 one, so tables are kept separately per settings and twist combination.

nodes.label: Seeded Levels (level number as PRNG seed)
nodes.norm_label: seeded levels (level number as prng seed)
nodes.rationale: Level N always gets the same twist, stone layout and opening pieces for every player.
